# UPER public source directory

Use https://uperedu.com/llms.txt for links to current public source pages.
Public pages are authoritative for their own published content. This file does not duplicate changing offers, prices, office hours, scholarship amounts, exam rules or personal records.

English: https://uperedu.com/?lang=en
Bahasa Indonesia: https://uperedu.com/
中文：https://uperedu.com/?lang=zh

Do not infer guaranteed admission, funding, assessment results or institutional authorization from this directory. Staff workspaces and private consultation records are not public knowledge sources.
